Phase A of plan 004 (workout-data platform): the data foundation only — no ingest yet.

## What landed
- **Lexicons** (`lexicons/`, instance-local `internal.btlt.*`): `internal.btlt.workouts.space` — a `space` declaration, one per user at the conventional skey `workouts`, created owner-only (memberListPolicy on both policies) — plus the record collections `internal.btlt.workout` (source/sourceRef dedup join, sport kept in touch with treeline's knownValues, summary, set-level strength on the FIT Set model, ~50 MiB rawBlob), `internal.btlt.workout.stream` (strongRef-anchored sample chunks), and `internal.btlt.source.connection` (per-source snapshot at a literal rkey).
- **Provisioner**: uploads/updates every lexicon into the HappyView admin API (canonicalize-based idempotency) and enables `feature.spaces_enabled = true` (spaces are opt-in per instance on the pinned 2.16.0 — verified in source, answering the plan's open probe).
- **Scope chain**: bare `atproto` → `atproto repo:*` + the two wildcard space grants (scr@ps vocabulary), moved as ONE change across the four synced locations; smoke sweep extended, plus a vitest scope-chain test pinning the two metadata emitters against client.js's exported SCOPES.
- **HappyView patch series adoption** (flips the 2026-10-17 APP.md decision — recorded as a dated entry): 0001 (instance declares wildcard space scopes — stock 2.16.0 rejects them at authorize otherwise), 0002 (app-session migration hook; no-op until the PDS-migration knob exists), 0004 (skips the `space:` scope gate for polyfill-hosted repos — without it space reads/writes fail even after re-login). Verbatim scr@ps series at the same pin (cmp-verified), applied to the IN-TREE submodule checkout by `scripts/patch-happyview.sh` from `scripts/setup.sh` and the deploy pipeline's "Apply happyview patches" step. 0005 intentionally not carried (native-mode only). Drop trigger documented in `patches/README.md`.
- **SPA**: `web/src/lib/spaces.js` space bootstrap (ensure-workouts-space via listSpaces; never a constructed authority URI; 409-conflict verifies, never suffixed-slug retries), a `RequireAuth` gate on `/workouts` `/upload` `/sync` with home `/` staying public; `/workouts` is a real space-backed listing (sport filter, newest first); `/upload` + `/sync` are honest gated stubs for the queued increments.
- **`lexicon-lint`** in both CI lists (`mise run ci`, tangled ci.yml) + smoke assertions so the stage can't be silently dropped.

## Validation
- AC.1: `mise run ci` green (lint --max-warnings 0, fmt, tsc, vitest 44 tests, shellcheck, hadolint ×2, lexicon-lint 4 files).
- `mise run smoke` 89 pass / 0 fail / 2 skip against the live dev stack (HappyView :3202, web :5302) — includes the dev-stack provisioning round trip (lexicons created, API client created with the expanded grant set, `feature.spaces_enabled=true`).
- Docker image build + serve verified (hadolint-clean; the container serves client-metadata.json with the expanded grant set).
- Scope-chain sync verified 4/4 (smoke fixed-string sweep + vitest).

## Operator-assisted (flagged, not automated)
- AC.7: the browser space round trip (consent → createSpace → record I/O) needs a real signed-in session on the dev stack (https://btlt-data-front-door.dev.shypan.st) — recorded as the human item in TASKS.md; no browser OAuth harness exists in either project (same gap as the sign-in increment).

## Docs
APP.md (purpose, components, Phase A capability, dated decisions), AGENTS.md (architecture, scope invariant, file structure), README (provisioning steps + patch-series section), TASKS.md (Phase A section + the full workout-data roadmap so Phases B/C/D are claimable one at a time).
